models.model_label: Model A: relation between aggregate EPL and operating-cost stickiness, full sample
models.sample_description: Annual firm-year panel of publicly listed non-financial firms from Compustat Global and North America in 19 OECD countries, estimated over 1990–2008. The initial data span 1988–2008 to provide lags. The final estimation sample contains 128,333 firm-year observations for 15,833 firms after the stated variable, currency, outlier, and sales-change screens; country-specific GDP deflators are used.
models.method_details: The authors state that OLS gives unbiased and consistent estimates for the combined Model A equation under their assumptions. They report t-values with two-way clustering by country and year.
